evidence.actual: Same-episode independent-rim estimates: steps 100/104/106/108/110/112 give travel 0.074/5.374/5.394/5.435/5.519/5.519 mm. Measured tip remains approximately 12 mm above its commanded endpoint; this demonstrates tracking lag, not force obstruction.
evidence.hypotheses: Rigid vertical cap motion, baseline ray-plane height, RGB table height and 2 mm/pixel sensitivity are declared visual engineering hypotheses, not true object geometry.
evidence.excluded: Do not use the jumping full-contour fit or the absolute-radius fit that reached its lateral search bound. Historical samples do not satisfy the new fresh-observation trigger.

measurement_gates.baseline: Use this episode's independent-camera unpressed RGB rim template captured before pressing-hand approach. Verify its timestamp, camera calibration and unchanged observer pose. Never replace it with a pressed image. If unavailable, safely release, establish a visibly unpressed baseline and restart without counting the incomplete cycle.
measurement_gates.fresh: One new timestamped RGB observation after each completed actor decision, paired with measured robot state; never reuse a frame.
measurement_gates.valid: Match only visible template-rim pixels under the vertical rigid-cap model, with no free radius or lateral-pose search. Require at least 60% template-rim visibility, including three separated rim sectors; RMS <=1 pixel; no matched residual >2 pixels; and a unique interior solution. Reject finger boundaries, saturation and observer motion.
measurement_gates.interval: For valid travel t, use engineering interval [t-2,t+2] mm from the declared sensitivity; this is not a calibrated confidence interval. Occluded sectors supply no evidence.

controller.unchanged: Original native IK, drives, joint bounds and proxy thresholds. Each decision uses 1..5 native 40 ms steps; enforce LINK6 <=50 mm and <=0.35 rad. Stop before exceeding 700 total physical steps; 588 remain at this packet.
controller.locks: During descent, diagnostic HOLD and release, actively retain the latched world tip XY and orientation.

actor_questions.constraint: Require X/Y and all rotations HOLD. Descent requires actual actor Z-negative; release requires Z-positive. Z-HOLD actively retains references and never authorizes endpoint deepening.

endpoint.definitions: z0 is the existing measured unpressed-tip reference; zTable is the RGB table-height hypothesis. All lengths below are millimeters.
endpoint.maximum_depth: Dmax=min(27.7-6, z0-(zTable+2+2)). The second term retains the 2 mm table guard plus a 2 mm visual allowance. Unknown reference values must be obtained from permitted evidence, never invented.
endpoint.update: After authorization, Dnew=min(Dold+2,Dmax), zEndpoint=z0-Dnew. No more than one update or 2 mm additional target depth per observation.
endpoint.limits: At most four endpoint updates and fifteen fresh action observations per press attempt; one attempt per requested cycle. Stop deepening when Dmax is reached. Check predicted tool-mesh swept clearance as well as measured clearance.

stages.name: DESCEND_OR_HOLD
stages.predicate: All measurement, containment and clearance gates hold.
stages.action: Continue the stored absolute endpoint or active HOLD. Record fresh travel and measured tip motion.

stages.name: ADAPT
stages.predicate: Three consecutive fresh valid action observations each have t<7.87 mm, their travel range is <0.5 mm, and measured tip-Z range is also <0.5 mm. Update budget and table clearance remain available.
stages.action: Propose one bounded endpoint update; apply only upon actor Z-negative. Reset the three-observation window after any update.

stages.name: RELEASE
stages.predicate: Fresh valid t>=7.87 mm and t-2>0, or any failure/attempt limit occurs.
stages.action: Command full 27 mm upward travel from the lowest measured tip Z of this attempt, retaining XY/orientation. Allow at most ten release decisions, subject to the global budget.

stages.name: VERIFY_REBOUND
stages.predicate: Measured upward travel >=27 mm and two consecutive valid observations show |t|<=2 mm with travel difference <0.5 mm.
stages.action: Count one visible cycle only if the press predicate previously passed; then advance the requested sequence. Otherwise stop without counting.

planner_response.failure: On lost travel validity or geometric containment, immediately stop descent and disable adaptation; release vertically only through a verified clear path. If clearance is unknown or release fails, HOLD and request intervention. Never move laterally to recover while depressed. Report visible-cycle evidence only, never electrical activation or task success.

compiled_notes: New cold development variant; no success asserted. Existing first-red/9-middle-red/blue order and native IK remain.
